title: Cartwise+ Membership Fresh Paid Period After a Plan Switch and the Pause Allowance
content:
A Cartwise+ Membership member who has just switched plans already holds a fresh paid period, and how its days count against the pause allowance is set by what the switch charged.

**Rule.**

- When the plan switch took effect in the last month and the latest plan-switch charge is at least the plan's period fee, the allowance is reduced by the calendar days from today up to the day before the next renewal date.
- When the plan switch took effect in the last month and the latest plan-switch charge is below the plan's period fee, it is reduced by half of those days, rounded down to a whole day.
- Otherwise it is not reduced.

## Figures the rule turns on

The plan's period fee is that of the plan the membership now holds:

| Plan held | Period fee (USD) |
|---|---|
| Cartwise+ Assist Monthly | 4.49 |
| Cartwise+ Student Monthly | 4.99 |
| Cartwise+ Monthly | 9.99 |
| Cartwise+ Annual | 99.00 |
| Cartwise+ Family Annual | 119.00 |
| Cartwise+ Premier Annual | 179.00 |

- **Plan switch in the last month**: the plan-switch date on the membership record is fewer than one whole month before today; a switch dated on the same day of the month one month back is not in the last month.
- **Latest plan-switch charge**: the most recent fee charge of the plan-switch type on the membership.
- **Days counted**: the calendar days from today up to the day before the next renewal date, both included.

## Decision table

| Switch in the last month | Latest plan-switch charge against the plan's period fee | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| yes | equal or higher | all of the days counted |
| yes | lower | half of the days counted, rounded down |
| no | any | none |

## Hypothetical cases (plan held Cartwise+ Monthly)

| Switch date | Today | Next renewal | Latest plan-switch charge | Reduction |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10 June | 10 June | 10 July | 9.99 | 30 days (10 June up to 9 July) |
| 10 June | 10 June | 10 July | 0.78 | 15 days (half of 30) |
| 10 June | 11 June | 10 July | 0.78 | 14 days (half of 29, rounded down) |
| 10 May | 10 June | 10 July | 0.78 | none (one whole month back) |
